title: ElectroCAD Project (.ecad), format version 5
description: The Native format. See docs/formats/ecad.md for the meaning of each field. Strict on purpose: the tests check that every key the app writes is described here. Opening a file refuses anything it doesn't describe (ADR-0014). Uses only a plain subset of JSON Schema (type, const, enum, required, properties, additionalProperties, items, minItems, maxItems, minimum, minLength, oneOf, $ref).

version.description: Goes up with every format change. Before 1.0 there is no compatibility: a file of any other version is refused (ADR-0014).

parts.description: Every Part used, keyed by its Library origin ("library/partId@version"), so Parts from different Libraries never clash. Frozen copies (ADR-0004).

footprints.description: Footprints Components use that are not one of their Part's Preferred footprints, stored once and referenced by key from Component.footprint.fpKey.

showSheetRefs.description: Global labels show the other sheets their net is on, e.g. [3,5] (#76), unless a label says otherwise. New projects: true; absent: false.

textFont.description: How schematic text is drawn (Sheet setup): the system font (absent: the default) or the vector font with Eagle's metrics (#79; Eagle imports use it).

titleBlock.description: The title block fields shown on every Sheet (#59). Sheet name and number are filled in per Sheet.

default.description: Key in styles: the Project's default Field style.

styles.description: Every Field style the Project uses, keyed by style id (ADR-0012).

nm.description: A length or coordinate in nanometres (ADR-0003).

id.description: Same as its key in parts.

prefix.description: Reference designator prefix, e.g. R, C, U.

keywords.description: Space-separated search words for the Part picker.

origin.description: Library origin, for Update from Library (#39).

units.description: ADR-0005: always an array, usually one Unit.

pinMap.description: pinMap[fpId][pinNumber] = padNumber. A missing entry means Pin n -> Pad n.

name.description: A, B, C… for multi-Unit Parts.

pinNameSize.description: Pin name text height. Default: 0.8 of the field text height (about 1 mm).

pinNumberSize.description: Pin number text height. Default: 0.8 of the field text height (about 1 mm), whatever pinNameSize is.

pinNameOffset.description: Gap between a pin's inner end and its name. Default 0.6 mm.

name.description: "~" means no name. ~{…} draws a bar over the text inside (#63): "~{RESET}", "IS/~{RD}".

at.description: The connection tip, in the Symbol's frame.

dir.description: From the tip into the body.

shape.description: Its mark (#63): an inversion bubble at the body, a clock wedge inside it, or both. Default line.

showName.description: false: its name isn't shown (#63), whatever the Unit's hidePinNames. Default true.

showNumber.description: false: its number isn't shown (#63), whatever the Unit's hidePinNumbers. Default true.

boardDrawing.description: A Board drawing (#66), in board nm. Widths are pen widths in nm (absent: the layer's default); text is mirrored on the B.* layers.

size.description: Text height, in the board's text font.

at.description: The centre of the text (its anchor when align is set); without rot it is drawn upright, whatever the Symbol's or Footprint's rotation.

rot.description: Footprint text (#84): degrees anticlockwise relative to the Footprint; it turns with it and is kept readable.

align.description: Footprint text (#84): `at` is this point of the text (Eagle's anchors).

spin.description: Footprint text (#84): never turned the other way up.

generated.description: A courtyard an importer made because the library had none (#67; older Eagle imports): DRC reports its overlaps as warnings.
A courtyard an importer made because the library had none (#67): DRC reports its overlaps as warnings.

mid.description: Any point on the arc between start and end (three points, so no angles are stored).

strokeScale.description: Multiplier on the standard line width (not nm).

graphics.description: Shapes with a layer: F.SilkS, F.CrtYd, F.Fab…

shape.description: chamfer (#70): a rectangle with its corners cut (an octagon by default).

chamfer.description: chamfer pads: how far each corner is cut, as a fraction of the shorter side. Absent: 0.2929, a regular octagon on a square.

corners.description: chamfer pads: the corners cut. Absent: all four.

innerSize.description: Through-hole pads (#82): the pad's diameter on the inner copper layers, where it is round (Eagle's inner restring). Absent: the same as on top and bottom.

ref.description: Reference designator, unique in the Project, no spaces.

value.description: As typed; Field styles only change how it is drawn.

fpId.description: A Preferred footprint: key in the Part's footprints. Pins map to Pads by the Part's pinMap.

fpKey.description: Any other Footprint: key in the Project's footprints. Pin n maps to Pad n.

fieldStyle.description: Key in fieldStyles.styles; absent = the Project default.

grid.description: This Sheet's snap grids. Holding Alt while drawing, moving or resizing uses the alt grid. Markup snaps to half the grid.

origin.description: This Sheet's grid origin: the grid, rulers and coordinates measure from it.

name.description: Unique in the Project regardless of case, no "/".

drawings.description: Markup: text notes, lines, rectangles, circles and arcs (#59). Never connects.

symbol.description: One placed Unit of a Component.

locked.description: A locked part doesn't move, rotate or mirror (absent: unlocked).

fieldPins.description: Pinned fields (#53): field key -> text centre in the Symbol's own frame.

bus.description: A Bus segment (#64): drawn like a Wire, carrying no connection; Nets cross it by name. Segments that touch are one Bus and share its name.

name.description: Its members, Eagle's notation: names and ranges separated by commas, D[0..7] (D0…D7), A,B,~{WR}; Eagle's alias ATBUS:A[0..31] (ATBUS names the Bus) and KiCad's {SIG1 SIG2} are read too. Empty: not named yet.

net.description: Matched regardless of case (ADR-0013); stored as typed.

bus.description: A Bus label (#64): sits on a Bus and shows its name (net); it names no Net.

shape.description: How a Net or Global label looks (#81): the name written on the wire, or a pointed flag. Absent: by scope (local text, global flag). Scope alone decides what it joins.

showRefs.description: A Global label's own choice to show sheet references (#76). Absent: the Schematic's showSheetRefs.

noConnect.description: A no-connect marker on a Pin tip (#11).

drawings.description: Text and graphics on the Board's own layers: silk, fab, courtyard, mask, paste or copper (#66; core/boardDrawings.js). Absent: none.

textFont.description: The metrics of board text, on screen and in the silk Gerbers (Board setup): ElectroCAD's stroke font, size = capital height (absent: the default), or the vector font, size = full height as Eagle's (#79; Eagle imports use it).

preset.description: The Fab preset the rules came from, for reference (core/presets.js ids, e.g. jlcpcb-2; #24).

fab.description: Fab output settings, filled by a Fab preset and editable (#24; used by the Fab output, #26).

naming.description: Gerber file names: Protel extensions (.GTL, .GBL…) or descriptive names (-F_Cu.gbr…).

grid.description: The snap grids (#15). Holding Alt while drawing, moving or resizing uses the alt grid.

origin.description: The grid origin: the grid lines, rulers and coordinates are measured from it.

annotation.description: What the Board was last told by Forward annotation (#16). The Board draws References, Values and Pad nets from here, and the next annotation lists the differences.

nets.description: Net name -> the Pads on it.

outline.description: Edge.Cuts shapes: lines and arcs forming closed loops (#15).

pairs.description: Clearance between different nets per pair of object kinds (#68): track (and zone fills, copper drawings), pad (through-hole or SMD), via. A pair set here replaces the Default class's clearance for those two kinds; an explicit Net class can still ask for more. Unset pairs use the classes' clearances.

builtin.description: A copy of one of the app's built-in styles.

library.description: Where it came from, e.g. builtin-mini or a user Library name.

netName.description: A Net by name (ADR-0015), matched regardless of case (ADR-0013).

boardFootprint.description: Where a Component sits on the Board. Its Footprint comes from the Component (ADR-0008), not copied here.

rot.description: Degrees counter-clockwise, 0 to less than 360, rounded to 0.01 (ADR-0015).

texts.description: This placement's own Reference / Value text (#65), in the Footprint's frame; absent: where the Footprint draws them.

rot.description: Degrees anticlockwise, relative to the Footprint.

layer.description: As on a front-side Footprint (F.SilkS, F.Fab…); a back-side one draws it on B.*.

tented.description: Covered by solder mask (the default). false: the mask is opened round the via, as for a test point.

zone.description: The fill is not stored: it is recomputed from the outline and rules (ADR-0015).

connect.description: How same-Net pads join the fill: thermal reliefs (gap and spokes) or solid. Thermal when absent.

minWidth.description: The narrowest copper the fill keeps (#82): parts narrower are taken away, as a pen this wide fills it (Eagle's polygon width). Absent or 0: no minimum.

keepIslands.description: Keep fill pieces that touch none of the Zone's own Net's copper (Eagle's orphans="yes"). Default false: they are removed.
